product_overview: Aplicación web de gestión de usuarios con autenticación JWT y control de acceso por roles. Permite a usuarios registrarse, iniciar sesión, administrar su perfil y, para administradores, gestionar el listado de usuarios con búsqueda, filtrado, paginación y CRUD.
core_goals: Registrarse como nuevo usuario con rol estándar
Iniciar sesión y acceder a la sección correspondiente según el rol
Ver y actualizar el propio perfil
Cambiar la contraseña de la cuenta
Administrar usuarios desde un panel para administradores
Buscar, filtrar y paginar el listado de usuarios
Crear, editar y eliminar usuarios de forma lógica
Proteger rutas según sesión y rol
Mostrar una página 404 para rutas inexistentes

features.name: User Login
features.description: Permite acceder a la aplicación con email y contraseña, almacenando la sesión para redirigir al área adecuada según el rol.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See redirected area for the authenticated role
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See alert with "Credenciales inválidas" and remain on the login page

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Permite crear una cuenta pública con nombre, email y contraseña, y entrar automáticamente al perfil con rol de usuario.
user_flows: Navigate to /registro -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Fill in password confirmation -> Submit registration form -> See profile with role shown as Usuario
Navigate to /registro -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in weak password -> Fill in password confirmation -> Submit registration form -> See validation errors
Navigate to /registro -> Fill in name -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Fill in mismatched password confirmation -> Submit registration form -> See validation errors

features.name: Profile management
features.description: Permite ver el perfil propio, editar nombre y email, cambiar la contraseña y cerrar sesión.
user_flows: Navigate to /perfil -> View current role, name, and email -> Edit name and email -> Save profile changes -> See updated profile data
Navigate to /perfil -> View current role, name, and email -> Enter current password -> Enter new password -> Confirm new password -> Submit password change -> See password update confirmed
Navigate to /perfil -> Click logout -> See redirected to /login

features.name: User administration CRUD
features.description: Permite a administradores gestionar usuarios activos mediante listado, búsqueda, filtrado, paginación, creación, edición y borrado lógico con confirmación.
user_flows: Navigate to /usuarios -> View paginated users table -> Search by name or email -> Filter by role -> Paginate through the list -> See the list update
Navigate to /usuarios -> Create a new user -> Search for the newly created user -> Open edit flow -> Update user data -> Save changes -> See updated user in the list
Navigate to /usuarios -> Open delete flow for a user -> Confirm deletion -> See the user removed from the active list
Navigate to /usuarios -> Open delete flow for a user -> Cancel deletion -> See the user remain in the list

features.name: Route guarding and 404
features.description: Protege rutas según sesión y rol, redirige accesos no permitidos y muestra una página de error para rutas inexistentes.
user_flows: Access a protected route without a session -> See redirect to /login
Access /usuarios as a non-admin user -> See redirect to /perfil
Open an unknown route -> See "Página no encontrada"

tech_stack.other: Vite, fetch-based HTTP client, localStorage token (x-token)

routes.description: Redirects to /usuarios for admins or /perfil for regular users.
Admin users list with search, role filter and pagination.
Own profile with edit and password change.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Login with email and password. On success the JWT is stored in localStorage and the user is redirected by role; on failure an error alert shows "Credenciales inválidas".
user_interactions: See alert with "Credenciales inválidas" on invalid credentials

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Public signup with nombre, email, password and confirmation. On success it auto-logs in and lands on /perfil showing rol "Usuario".
user_interactions: See field validation errors on weak password or mismatched confirmation

features.name: Profile management
features.description: View and edit own profile (nombre, email), change password (requires current password) and logout.
user_interactions: View own role (data-test=profile-role), name and email
Edit nombre and email and save (data-test=profile-name, profile-email)

features.name: User administration CRUD
features.description: Admin-only list with search, role filter and pagination, plus create, edit and logical delete of users with a confirmation dialog.
user_interactions: Create user via "+ Nuevo usuario" (data-test=users-new) and UserFormView
Delete user (data-test=user-delete) and confirm (data-test=confirm-accept) or cancel (data-test=confirm-cancel)

features.name: Route guarding and 404
features.description: Session and role-based navigation guards plus a 404 page for unknown routes.
user_interactions: Access a protected route without session redirects to /login
A non-admin user accessing /usuarios is redirected to /perfil
A guest accessing /login or /registro while authenticated is redirected home

known_limitations.issue: Logout is client-only (removes the localStorage token); the JWT is not revoked server-side.
known_limitations.impact: A copied token remains valid until it expires.

known_limitations.issue: The users list pagination is hardcoded to 8 rows per page in the UI.
known_limitations.impact: The page size cannot be changed from the interface.

known_limitations.issue: The API base URL defaults to /api (Vite dev proxy) unless VITE_API_URL is set.
known_limitations.impact: The frontend requires the API on the same origin (or a proxy) to work.
